page.title: File services
page.webdavDesc: Reuses the main HTTP port (80) under /dav; supports Windows drive mapping
page.sftpDesc: Standalone SFTP endpoint; works with sshfs mounts and clients like WinSCP

form.bindAddressHint: 0.0.0.0 listens on all interfaces; recommended for LAN use only

dialog.enableDesc: Once enabled, clients can access your files through this protocol. Continue?
dialog.disableDesc: All client connections will be dropped immediately. Continue?

webdav.windows: Windows: enable the WebClient service, then run net use Z: http://<host>/dav in Explorer or a command prompt
webdav.rclone: rclone: create a WebDAV remote with rclone config, set the URL to http://<host>/dav, and use your drive credentials
webdav.basic: Credentials are your drive login; Basic auth is plain HTTP — put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front for production
webdav.lock: LOCK is not implemented: Office online editing may fail to save; Explorer mounts are unaffected

sftp.winscp: WinSCP / FileZilla: choose SFTP, port {{port}}, and use your drive credentials
sftp.readonly: SFTP supports sequential writes only; random writes, hard links and symlinks fail explicitly
